title: Where each fact is born
sub: Data architecture, a series on what DAMA calls data architecture, between the business and the systems: where each fact is born, its system of record, one home and one owner for it, every copy with a line back to where it came from, and what's left to master data when two places have to create the same thing.
howto: Glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model: gold is the business layer, peach the information layer, where data architecture works. Each system is a glass card; a fact born there is marked with a small gold star, and a copy is drawn fainter, with a dashed line back to where it was born. Chile in 1972 is drawn in lamp-light: the telex lines, the factories, and the strips of paper each one sent.
